column1: # Guest functions that are not translated but covered (read by xrc --override="Final Fantasy XIII"; the ovr_*.c here
# are copied with the pages to <out>/overrides/ and compiled with the runtime):
#   manual       a hand-written replacement in ovr_*.c (here) (the runtime's xrc_manual_* tables)
#   wrapped      translated, but replaced in the dispatcher by a hand-written function that falls back to the
#                translation (so no translation calls it directly)
#   fast         translated (the reference), but replaced by a hand-written xo_<addr> (ovr_simd.c) that
#                the translations call directly and the dispatcher maps to
#   unreachable  reached only from replaced functions / dead code (the runtime still stops with the override reason
